PHASE6_ASHUGANJ_CCPP_CLOSED_LOOP_TRIP/Generator

PDF-SUPPORTED FACTS
  • Siemens SGen5-2000H: 458 MVA, 22 kV, 50 Hz, 3000 rpm.Generator Name Plate_South.pdf · p. 2

  • Viscous-loss coefficient F=0.001 pu and 10 W numerical shunt are study choices.
